entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Please say or enter your order number.
Thank you. Connecting you to an agent now.
Hi, thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is Sarah. I see you're calling about your recent order. How can I help you today?
Hi... yes. I got this package, and I think I need to send it back. It's the helmet I ordered. I'm just so confused by the website.
I can certainly look into that for you. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the helmet? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?

Oh, um, I guess preference? The color on the website looked different. I haven't even taken it out... the box is unopened because I wasn't sure if that would void the warranty or affect its safety rating. I don't know what to do. Can't you just help me?

Of course, I can absolutely help you. It's no problem at all. Since you just received it two days ago and it's a preference issue with the color, you're well within our 90-day return policy for items like this helmet.
Oh, 90 days? I couldn't find that anywhere. It was all so overwhelming. So I can send it back?

Yes, definitely. I'm processing the return for you now. I've just sent a prepaid return shipping label to the email address on your account. You can just print that out, tape it to the box, and drop it off at any post office.
Wow, okay. That's... actually really easy. Thank you so much, Sarah. I really appreciate it.

You're very welcome! Once we receive the helmet back at our warehouse, you'll see a full refund to your original payment method within 3 to 5 business days. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Nope, that's everything. You've been a huge help. Thanks again!
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
